clauses.scope_note: GPL-2.0, introductory permission: verbatim copies of the license document may be copied. This concerns the license text itself, not a Program licensed under it.
clauses.condition_explanation: The copy must be verbatim; changing the license document is not allowed.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-2.0, introductory permission: verbatim copies of the license document may be distributed. This concerns the license text itself, not a Program licensed under it.
clauses.condition_explanation: The distributed copy must be verbatim; changing the license document is not allowed.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-2.0, introductory restriction on changing the license document itself; it does not state a restriction on modifying a Program under the GPL.
clauses.condition_explanation: The text expressly says changing the license document is not allowed.

obligation_items.content: Do not change the GPL license document.
obligation_items.trigger: when acting on a copy of the license document
